info.name: Vybli API
info.description:
Vybli backend — REST + Socket.IO.

Requests are ordered as a **walkthrough**, not an index: run them top to bottom and the collection signs you up, onboards you, finds someone, connects, chats, calls and pays.

The scripts do the token wrangling for you. `Request OTP` stores the dev code, `Verify OTP` stores the tokens, and later requests capture the ids they create — so you never paste a cuid by hand.

Set `base_url` if the server is not on localhost:4000.

exec: // Applies to every request in the collection.
pm.test('responds with the standard envelope', function () {

item.name: 01 · Reference data
item.description: Public — the onboarding screens need these before anyone is signed in.

item.name: Languages — alias search
item.description: "bangla" must find Bengali. A language you cannot find by the name you grew up with reads as one the app does not have.

exec: // A fresh number each run, so the collection can be replayed.

item.name: Refresh session
item.description: Rotates: the old refresh token dies here, so a stolen one is good only until the owner next refreshes.

item.name: 03 · Onboarding
item.description: Resumable. Ask /status and go where it says — closing the app halfway costs nothing.

item.name: 4 · Location
item.description: Also derives the role: gender decides earnMoney vs makeFriends the moment this lands, and isEarner is set here — there is no separate mode step.

item.name: 7 · Choose avatar (earners only)
item.description: A predefined avatar, picked by id from GET /avatars?gender=female — not an upload. Identity review itself is manual and happens after Complete, from the admin panel.

item.name: 8 · Complete
item.description: Re-checks everything rather than trusting the status column, and names the first gap if any.

item.name: Go online
item.description: Normally driven by the socket connecting; here so REST-only testing can be reached by a caller.

item.name: Turn messaging off
item.description: A full opt-out: the chat list empties with messaging_disabled: true, requests are refused, calls are unaffected.

item.name: Feed — my city
item.description: Captures the first result as {{peer_id}} for the requests below.

item.name: Random match
item.description: Returns the match only — placing the call is a separate step, so Skip costs nothing.

item.name: Connection status
item.description: none | requestSent | requestReceived | friends — the four states the profile button renders.

item.name: Incoming requests
item.description: Always empty for a Make Friends account — only earners can receive one.

item.name: Accept request
item.description: Run this as the *recipient*. Creates the friendship and the conversation together.

item.name: Unfriend
item.description: Deletes the conversation too — a thread you cannot reply to is a dead end.

item.name: Chats — Requests tab
item.description: Pending requests shaped as threads: the app models them as a conversation at an earlier status.

item.name: Open thread
item.description: Reading it is what marks it read.

item.name: Start a call
item.description: The balance must cover the first minute before it rings.

item.name: Accept (as the callee)
item.description: Minute one is charged here.

item.name: End call
item.description: The summary in the reply is what the Call Ended screen renders.

request.description: A fresh join token for a call already in progress. Tokens are short-lived on purpose — a leaked long one is a way into somebody's conversation — so a long call that has to reconnect asks for another instead.

item.name: Active call
item.description: How a client that restarted mid-call rejoins instead of losing it.

item.name: Buy coins
item.description: Names a package; the server prices it. An endpoint accepting an amount would be a free-money endpoint.

item.name: Buy coins — declined
item.description: pkg_2500 always fails, so the payment-failure screen is reachable without editing code.

item.name: Block
item.description: A full severance: friendship and conversation deleted, live call ended, messages and calls refused.

item.name: Unblock
item.description: Restores nothing — send a fresh request like anyone else.

item.name: Delete account
item.description: Irreversible. The row is kept and scrubbed so history stays intact; the phone number is released for reuse.

item.name: 13 · LiveKit
item.description: The media path. This server issues room-scoped tokens and tears the room down when a call ends; LiveKit carries the audio and video.

item.name: Is media available on this deployment?

request.description: The app reads this at startup so it can disable calling with a reason rather than ringing into silence.

LiveKit posts here when a room finishes or a participant drops, which is how a call ends when a phone dies mid-conversation instead of billing into a dead handset. It arrives with no user session, so the signature is the only thing guarding it — sending this by hand should be refused.
